name: honda_l15b7_epa_turbo
source: [AS] [AS] one GT28-class turbo (the real engine has a single-scroll MHI unit, not read here); template single_small.json with target_boost_bar 0.90 bar gauge = the highest-torque envelope row's MAP maximum (195.6 kPa abs, [M]) minus ISA 101.325 kPa, floored to 0.05 bar.
